subject: Renewal procurement — acceptance criteria, staggered PO release & portal re-enrollment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Paula Fernandez <procure_ops@acme-health.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal procurement — acceptance criteria, staggered PO release & portal re-enrollment

Hi Paula,

Thanks for yesterday's call — good to align on the top-level commercials. Per follow-up, I'm sending a concise checklist to unblock procurement on our side and a proposed PO cadence so your finance team can plan approvals. Key asks are below.

Attachments: Acme-SOW-v3.pdf (proposed SOW with the seat/throughput ladder) and mutual-action-plan.xlsx (action items + owners).

Acceptance criteria we need to lock before the initial PO:
- Performance: 95th percentile generation latency <= 180ms for the baseline prompt set (we'll share a short eval set).
- Data controls: Row-level isolation enabled for Prod workspace; KMS key ownership confirmed.
- Security: SOC2 snapshot (attached) accepted as evidence; any gaps to be listed as action items.
- Onboarding: Vendor portal re-enrollment completed (supplier profile + bank details) so PO/ invoices can be processed.

PO release proposal (staggered):
- Release 1 (initial): 40% of committed seats, effective on go-live, to cover initial capacity and onboarding.
- Release 2 (30%): triggered when usage > 60% of Release 1 baseline for two consecutive weeks.
- Release 3 (30%): final reconciliation at renewal effective date.

Benefits: this reduces short-term spend commitments for Acme while giving capacity headroom during ramp. If legal prefers a single PO we can mirror the same ladder as line items in one PO — happy to coordinate with your procurement.

Next steps (can we target these dates?):
- Confirm vendor portal re-enrollment deadline: 2026-06-21
- Procurement sign-off on staggered PO approach: 2026-06-23
- DocuSign send for SOW/Order Form: 2026-06-24

If you want I can loop in our procurement ops lead (Jonas) and legal (Marissa) now.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: Paula Fernandez <procure_ops@acme-health.com>

Cc: Andrew Mills <andrew@helixinc.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement — acceptance criteria, staggered PO release & portal re-enrollment

Ben,

Appreciate the concise checklist — helpful. A few clarifications from our procurement side:

1) Portal re-enrollment: we'll complete supplier profile + bank info, but our vendor-team needs an NSU (supplier unique id) to map payments. Can you confirm Redwood's supplier code or share the portal invite link?

2) SOC2 snapshot: our security team will review the attached PDF. If they flag a control gap we usually accept a mitigation plan tied to the mutual action plan; please ensure Marissa is OK with any outstanding items being action items and not contract blockers.

3) PO cadence: the staggered release is acceptable in principle. Internal requirement: initial PO should include a short acceptance window (30 days) tied to the acceptance criteria you listed. We need to show our audit team the acceptance test steps for latency and data isolation. Do you have a one-page acceptance test doc?

Proposed dates look fine but we need the portal invite by EOD 6/18 so our supplier team can process the initial PO on 6/21.

I'll loop in our finance partner (Andrew) to confirm the payment terms once we have the PO draft.

Thanks,
Paula
Procurement Operations Manager
Acme Health
procure_ops@acme-health.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal procurement — acceptance criteria, staggered PO release & portal re-enrollment

Team — forwarding Paula's note. Quick internal sync points before we reply:

On acceptance tests: we have a short acceptance doc (I pulled the checklist into mutual-action-plan.xlsx) but legal prefers a signed-off set of steps. Proposed owner: Jonas to draft the test steps (latency run, KV cache isolation verification, KMS key check) and share as a one-pager.

On SOC2 gaps: Marissa — can you confirm if we accept remediation plans as action items (non-blocking) for standard controls? If so, we'll mark any flagged control as "remediation plan required" and track in the MAP.

On portal invite + supplier id: Laura — can you trigger the portal re-enrollment invite (supplier portal: Redwood Vendor Center) and include the Supplier Unique ID that Acme needs. If we can get that out by EOD 6/18 we meet Paula's timeline.

On PO wording: propose that the initial PO references the staggered seat ladder in line items and contains a 30-day acceptance period tied to the one-pager. If legal approves this structure we can avoid multiple separate POs (Acme said they're open to either).

Action items:
- Jonas: one-pager acceptance test steps (due 2026-06-19)
- Laura: portal re-enroll invite + supplier id (send by 2026-06-18 EOD)
- Marissa: confirm remediation plan stance and redline any contract language that assumes SOC2 absolute compliance (due 2026-06-20)

I'll prepare a short reply to Paula offering to send the DocuSign envelope once we agree the acceptance one-pager.

Ben

Paula / Andrew —

Thanks — team hit the internal deadlines. A quick update and next steps:

1) Portal invite: Laura has sent the supplier re-enrollment invite. Supplier Unique ID: RW-ACME-2096. You should see the invite from Redwood Vendor Center; let me know if it doesn't come through and we'll resend.

2) Acceptance one-pager: Jonas attached a short test plan and we've added it to the MAP (see attached mutual-action-plan.xlsx). Summary steps:
   - Run 3x baseline prompts at target concurrency 
   - Measure 95th perc latency; threshold 180ms
   - Confirm KMS key ownership and a sample encrypted object retrieval test
   - Confirm row-level workspace isolation via test dataset (Jonas will coordinate test tokens)

3) SOC2: Marissa confirms remediation plans accepted for low/medium items; any high-severity gaps will be escalated and treated as blockers.

4) PO / DocuSign: I've prepared the SOW with the staggered seat ladder as line items and sent the DocuSign envelope (link below). Please review and sign the Order Form. Per Paula's timeline, releasing the initial PO on 2026-06-24 will allow us to activate the initial 40% capacity on 6/28.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/TxID/0a1b2c3d4e
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8472

If Acme signs by EOD 6/24 we'll plan the onboarding kickoff for 6/29 and run the acceptance tests the week of 6/29-7/3.

Paula — can you confirm the payment terms (Net30 vs Net45) so we can reflect it in the final Order Form?

Thanks everyone — closing this loop now.
